findings.evidence: The Workflow includes "Read what the plan depends on: README, manifests, config"; Prompt contents adds "Tasks must be small and independently testable" with an OAuth illustration. These are familiar repository-planning activation, whereas the distinctive knowledge is the manual Codex handoff and its operational gotchas.
findings.fix: Condense the routine repository-reading and task-sizing advice: retain the verified-path constraint, required task-field schema and requirement-coverage check, but omit the generic file-category enumeration and OAuth task-sizing illustration.

findings.evidence: "If either exists, ask whether to overwrite or use a `-2` suffix (both names); never overwrite silently." The new-name branch does not specify an outcome when prompt_to_codex-2.md or codex-plan-2.md also exists; selecting the prescribed suffix can therefore produce another collision.
findings.fix: Check both candidate filenames before writing. If either suffixed name exists, increment the suffix until both names are unused, or obtain explicit overwrite consent for that exact pair. Use the selected names in the generated prompt, displayed command and request for the returned plan.
